messages:
rachel: ping — ResellCo raised a billing discrepancy: GCP Marketplace usage for Mar 20-22 shows downstream customers getting partner-tier discounts applied incorrectly.

omar: Do we have a concrete example? sounds like tiered pricing (volume discounts) hit at partner total rather than per downstream customer?

rachel: Yes. Example attached by ResellCo. They say their downstream subscription tiers (bronze/silver/gold) weren't honored; partner aggregated usage pushed a higher tier discount to all downstreams.

jess-fin: That will underbill Redwood and over-credit partners/downstreams. Need to quantify delta and issue adjustments. Can we get sample rows?

resellco-ops: snippet from their export (they attached full CSV to ticket):
```
InvoiceDate,DownstreamCustomer,PartnerAccount,SKU,TierApplied,Units,UnitPrice,LineTotal
2026-03-21,resellco-cust-11,resellco-gcp-222,redwood-embed,partner-gold,10000,0.005,50.00
2026-03-21,resellco-cust-22,resellco-gcp-222,redwood-embed,partner-gold,2000,0.005,10.00
```
They expected per-customer tiers: cust-11 should be silver (unit $0.006), cust-22 bronze (unit $0.007). Partner-level aggregation mistakenly classified both as gold.

omar: Where do we apply tier logic in pipeline? ingress->pricing-service applies per-buyer lookup using buyer_to_customer and tier_table, right?

eng-qa: Pricing lookup happens in pricing-service; it uses downstream_customer_id to lookup tier. If downstream mapping fails and we only have partner account, fallback was to compute partner-level monthly volume and pick tier (legacy behavior). Looks like mapping failed for that window.

jess-fin: Ok. Finance needs a reconciliation report listing per-downstream: expected_line_total, invoiced_line_total, delta, invoice_ref. We'll use that to create debit memos for partners and credit memos for downstreams as appropriate.

resellco-ops: We found that our partner integration removed downstream_customer_id from the metering export between 2026-03-20T01:00Z and 2026-03-22T23:59Z due to a schema change in their pipeline. We uploaded the mapping file: downstream_id,tier,units for those dates.

rachel: Can eng/etl reprocess those rows using the partner mapping file? If we can reconstruct expected tiers we can compute adjustments.

eng-qa: We can reprocess if partner mapping is stable. Short-term approach: (1) run an offline reprice job joining partner mapping to raw usage; (2) produce reconciliation CSV; (3) coordinate credits/charges. ETA for reprice job run: 24hrs.

jess-fin: Format finance needs: downstream_id, invoice_id, original_units, original_price, expected_price, expected_total, delta_amount, action_reco. Please include GL code FIN-GCP-PRC.

resellco-ops: ResellCo gave signed PO to cover any net shortfall from incorrect discounts. They also agreed to re-export corrected metering with downstream_customer_id embedded going forward.

omar: Engineering follow-up: add an ingestion validation rule: fail ingest and alert when partner exports for reseller patterns omit downstream_customer_id for >1% of usage. Also add alert for sudden shift to partner-level tiering.

eng-qa: I'll open PR for validation + offline reprice job. Will stash artifacts under s3://billing-recon/resellco/2244668800/ and attach outputs to the Jira.

billing-bot: audit: ticket-8176 created, resellco_mapping_mar20-22.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-8176/ at 2026-03-22T12:34:05Z

jess-fin: Finance will wait for reconciliation CSV then prepare provisional memos marked 'provisional - pending partner re-export'. We will use FIN-GCP-PRC code and route approvals to CFO queue.

rachel: Linking JIRA BILL-8176. Keeping this thread open until reprice job runs and finance issues adjustments. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
